## Improved
- Play on: the remote mini player only appears after you move playback to another device or pick one to control, and goes away when playback comes back here or that device goes offline, including a device on your network that goes quiet for about a minute and a half (#1412)
- Play on: the sheet lists every device in one "Devices" group with the same rows as Settings, uses the music player's own controls, drops the seekbar, and shows a song's album art and a video's frame at their own shape, without black bars (#1412)
- Play on: the device chip reads "On this phone", "On this tablet" or "On this TV" when playing here, and the other device's name otherwise (#1412)
- Play on: the button now uses a speaker icon, and shows in the music mini player only while playback is on another device (#1412)
- Play on: bringing playback back to this device takes it from the device you are controlling (#1412)
